name: Form Pressing (Web)
implementation_notes: Reuses PressingRecordService::create()/update() (BE service shared with screen-050)

REVISED 2026-08-24 (entity-catalog v12, correcting the original design the user explicitly rejected): the Pressing Detail grid is now DYNAMIC -- addDetailRow()/removeDetailRow()/canAddRow()/availableTimeSlotOptions() now exist on FormPressing.php, exactly mirroring FormThreshing's just-fixed Threshing Detail grid (screen-057) and FormCagesTrack's Cages Tipped Time grid. Grid starts empty on create mode (was: built from PressingRecordService::canonicalTimeSlots() into 24 rows on mount); edit mode still loads existing rows verbatim with each row's id

All 6 reading-column inputs per row are genuinely editable number/text fields, never disabled -- unlike Form Cages Track Web's Total Cages/Cages Remain (computed, disabled as a documented uiux-spec exception), Pressing has no computed detail-grid fields, so the 'no disabled web inputs' rule applies with zero exceptions in this screen's detail grid
Target Operasional table queried directly by FormPressing::render(), never sent as part of the create/update payload
Route /data/pressing/create registered BEFORE /data/pressing/{id} (screen-054) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}
checked/acknowledged self-attestation checkboxes mirror FormThreshing's dual-checkbox pattern (both Checked By AND Acknowledged By, unlike Form Weighbridge/Grading Web which only have Acknowledged)

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) spec (backend/tests/Browser/FormPressingTest.php) was authored/revised for the dynamic grid but could not be executed in this sandboxed environment -- verified only by static review.
